lesson.title: Unit 8 Reading signs

sections.title: Listen and say
sections.english:
Woman: Excuse me. Where’s the underground station ↘?
Mark: It’s over there ↘. Can you see that sign ↗?
Woman: Yes ↘. Thank you ↘. I just came from Shanghai ↘. The sign for the underground station there is red ↘.
Mark: I see ↘. There are different signs in different cities ↘.
Woman: In the UK, the sign is a big red circle ↘. You can see the word “UNDERGROUND” in the middle ↘.
Mark: Are there any special signs in your country ↗?
Woman: Yes ↘. We have some animal signs ↘. Sometimes the animals use the roads too ↘. We must look out for them ↘.
Mark: That’s interesting ↘.
sections.chinese:
项目整理译文（对应用户补充对话）
女士：打扰一下，地铁站在哪里？
Mark：在那边。你能看到那个标识吗？
女士：能。谢谢。我刚从上海来。那里的地铁站标识是红色的。
Mark：我明白了。不同城市有不同的标识。
女士：在英国，标识是一个大红圈。中间可以看到“UNDERGROUND”这个词。
Mark：你们国家有特别的标识吗？
女士：有。我们有一些动物标识。有时动物也会使用道路。我们必须留意它们。
Mark：真有趣。

sections.title: 公共标识与含义
sections.english:
No smoking.
No swimming.
Look out for animals.
Keep quiet.
Mind the gaps.
sections.chinese:
禁止吸烟（No smoking.）
禁止游泳（No swimming.）
当心动物（Look out for animals.）
保持安静（Keep quiet.）
小心缝隙（Mind the gaps.，站台警示）

sections.title: Signs around us
sections.english:
We can see many signs around us. Different signs tell us different things.
Some signs tell us what we must do. Some tell us what we must not do.
We can see signs in the library, in the park, on the road and in the underground. They help us stay safe.
sections.chinese:
我们身边的标识
我们身边能看到很多标识。不同标识传递不同信息。
有些标识告诉我们必须做什么，有些告诉我们禁止做什么。
图书馆、公园、马路、地铁里都有标识。它们帮助我们保障安全。

lesson.sentencePattern: We must keep quiet. We shouldn’t smoke.
lesson.sentencePrompt: 用 must 或 shouldn’t 说一条规则。
